synopsis: The story of a possessed person in a book who will not hesitate to kill for her goal. Brinny, who lived in obedience to her stepfather, thought it had nothing to do with her. Until she got involved in an incident with the sickly second prince, Lucian. At a moment of crisis, Brinny used her supernatural powers to save Lucian, and was relieved that everything was resolved when she saw that the possessed person, 'Aridna', was captured. However, for some reason, her beloved sister and the first prince died in a carriage accident, and even Lucian, who became her fiancé, began to act strangely. Wasn't the possessed person executed in the past? Is 'Aridna' still alive? Brinny decides to reclaim the empty space left by the disappearance of her precious people. She will fight the possessed person. (Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title: Card Game de Sekai ga Horobu Sekai ni Tensei Shite Card Shop wo Kaiten Shitara, Shuui kara Zensaku Shujinkou da to Omowareteiru
titleRomaji: Card Game de Sekai ga Horobu Sekai ni Tensei Shite Card Shop wo Kaiten Shitara, Shuui kara Zensaku Shujinkou da to Omowareteiru
titleNative: カードゲームで世界が滅ぶ世界に転生してカードショップを開店したら、周囲から前作主人公だと思われている
synopsis: In worlds where card games dominate everything, it's almost a cliché for the fate of the world to hang on the outcome of a card battle. I, Mitsuru Tanefuda, found myself reincarnated into such a world. Thankfully, my dream came true—I became the manager of my very own card shop. In this world, people duel with cards, filled with joy and excitement, and I wanted to watch it all up close. But for some reason, everyone seems to think I'm some legendary hero who solved massive crises in the past, watching over the next generation like a noble predecessor. The truth is, I've never resolved any world-shaking incidents—not even once. This is the story of a reincarnated man who became the manager of a card shop in a world where card games take precedence over everything else. Despite having no great achievements to his name, everyone around him assumes he must have been a hero who once saved the world. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

He finds that his aptitude for weapons, magic, and all other combat-related skills is the lowest rank, so he takes odd-jobs repairing the castle walls and digging for minerals to make a living, where his exceptional abilities are immediately revealed. title: Reluctant Space Commander: From Death Wish to Galactic Hero!
titleRomaji: "Koko wa Makasete Saki ni Ike!" wo Shitai Shinitagari no Nozomanu Uchuu Gekokujou @COMIC
titleEnglish: Reluctant Space Commander: From Death Wish to Galactic Hero!
titleNative: 「ここは任せて先に行け！」をしたい死にたがりの望まぬ宇宙下剋上@COMIC
synopsis: Nao has had it rough. His girlfriend dumped him and ran off with another man, and now his life has lost all meaning. As he contemplates suicide, he catches sight of an advertisement for Space Force—a military force dedicated to protecting the planet from extraterrestrial threats. Finally, a sign that maybe he can do more with his pathetic existence! Without a moment’s hesitation, he joins the force with a simple plan in mind: he’ll sacrifice himself for his comrades after a suave line and be free. Except…Nao is too good at this job! Like, really good—there’s no way he’ll die on his own at this rate! Can Nao find his sweet release, or will he become a hero and have to live with it? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
chapterSourceTitle: "Koko wa Makasete Saki ni Ike!" o Shitai Shinitagari no Nozomanu Uchuu Gekokujou @COMIC
